# GetCameraStencil

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetCameraStencil:Int32 camera:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |

**Returns:** 1 if the camera has a stencil, 0 if not.

## Description

Tells whether a camera has a stencil buffer, as set with [SetCameraStencil](SetCameraStencil). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraStencil camera, True
Print GetCameraStencil(camera)
WaitKey
```
